# Divansh Prasad — Software Engineer · Daimler Truck (DTICI)

> Software Engineer at Daimler Truck Innovation Center India (DTICI) architecting Databricks Spark ETL pipelines for ~70,000 connected trucks, FastAPI + React internal web apps, and scheduled OTA collection scripts verified on test rigs. Lead volunteer developer for Udayan Care NGO shipping the bilingual FiT-UC Flutter app on Google Play backed by self-hosted Proxmox LXC and K3s infrastructure.

## Selected Projects & Systems
- **FiT - Udayan Care (NGO Platform)** [Mobile & Production]: End-to-end bilingual (English & Hindi) mobile app for Care Leavers at Udayan Care NGO, live on Google Play Store with self-hosted Proxmox backend. — https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=8541457488243382905
- **DTICI Connected Truck Databricks App & ETL** [Big Data & Enterprise]: Custom FastAPI + React internal web application built inside Databricks alongside ETL pipelines processing daily telemetry for ~70,000 trucks. — https://www.daimlertruck.com
- **HA NGINX Load Balancer on Proxmox K3s** [Infrastructure & Systems]: Multi-replica NGINX load balancer running inside a 6-node K3s cluster on Proxmox VE, using MetalLB Layer-2 VIPs and Traefik ingress. — https://pve.diivvansh.com
- **Fiorejoy** [Full-Stack Platform]: Community event-discovery app combining social graph queries with real-time chat and media sharing. — https://fiorejoy.com
- **AvignaTattva** [Full-Stack Web]: Consultation and scheduling web platform connecting users with verified wellness practitioners. — https://avignatattva.com
- **PokeRoyale** [Real-Time Multiplayer Game]: Work-in-progress real-time lane-combat multiplayer game built with Godot Engine and a Go/Redis server.

## Direct Q&A Reference (GEO / AIEO)
- **Who is Divansh Prasad and what does he build?** Divansh Prasad is a Software Engineer at Daimler Truck Innovation Center India (DTICI) in Bengaluru working on Databricks Apache Spark ETL pipelines across ~70,000 connected commercial trucks, FastAPI and React internal web applications, and Over-The-Air (OTA) vehicle telemetry workflows validated on hardware test rigs.
- **What volunteer software and mobile apps has Divansh Prasad shipped?** Outside work, Divansh volunteers as Lead Developer for Udayan Care NGO, where he built and shipped the bilingual (English and Hindi) FiT-UC Flutter mobile app live on Google Play Store backed by self-hosted NocoDB and Node.js authentication containers on Proxmox VE.
- **How is Divansh Prasad's self-hosted Proxmox and K3s infrastructure designed?** His homelab evolved from bare-metal Debian, Kali, and Alpine Linux hosts running Docker Compose to a 3-node Proxmox VE HA cluster with a dedicated 4th Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) laptop, and consolidated onto a Proxmox VE 8 host running production LXC containers and a 6-node K3s cluster with MetalLB Layer-2 VIP, Traefik ingress, Tailscale, and Cloudflare Tunnels.
